It has no implementation, so it doesn't say whether Right+Up adds, averages, or gates the two keys, or what Alt and Ctrl change.
- **The library itself** isn't in this app. `node_modules/@babylonjs/lite` doesn't exist there, and I have no shell here to search for it.

I made no changes in `/home/dev/71ad06/app`. To answer, I need one of these:
